events.title: SEC approves spot Bitcoin ETFs
events.summary: The U.S. SEC approved spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds on January 10, 2024 — letting mainstream investors hold BTC exposure through brokerage accounts.
events.about: BlackRock, Fidelity, and other issuers listed ETFs that track bitcoin spot prices, routing billions from pensions and retail into custodied BTC. The decision ended a decade-long regulatory fight and linked TradFi portfolios directly to crypto's oldest asset.

narrative.whyChosen: Spot Bitcoin ETFs bridged Wall Street and on-chain BTC for the first time at scale.
narrative.whyImportant: It legitimized bitcoin as an institutional asset class in US markets.
narrative.problemSolved: Investors wanted BTC exposure without managing [private key]s or unregulated exchanges.

events.title: Elixir 1.16 released
events.summary: The Elixir team released Elixir 1.16 on January 28, 2024 with type inference in patterns, `Duration` and `DateTime` improvements, and faster compilation.
events.about: Elixir 1.16 brought gradual typing ergonomics to everyday code — inferring types in function heads and guards. Combined with OTP 26/27 [JSON] support, it kept the BEAM stack current for Phoenix, LiveView, and Nerves embedded apps.

narrative.whyChosen: Elixir 1.16 advanced type information without a full static type system.
narrative.whyImportant: Inferred types caught bugs earlier while preserving Elixir's dynamic feel.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams wanted more compile-time safety without adopting a separate typed language.

events.title: Samsung Galaxy S24 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy S24 — Galaxy AI on-device features integrated across the S24 line.
events.about: The Galaxy S series remained [Android]'s volume flagship counterweight to iPhone. Galaxy ai on-device features integrated across the s24 line. Developers testing [Android] builds routinely validated on Galaxy S hardware as the default non-[Pixel] reference.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy S24 continued Samsung's annual [Android] flagship cadence.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy S devices set the hardware bar millions of [Android] users and developers encounter.
narrative.problemSolved: [Android] needed consistent premium hardware for testing flagship features each year.
